messages:
Maya: Passing the night to @Chris — quick consolidated ops snapshot before I sign off.
Maya: Short TL;DR: embeddings autoscaler thrash at ~16:12 UTC led to burst of 503s for batch embed jobs, eu-west routing had transient packet loss, and we observed a KV eviction regression after the 2.3.1 rollout. Customer impact: small number of batch jobs delayed (~5-10% of teams), realtime API p95 unaffected.
ops-bot: [incident] pager triggered: embeddings-autoscaler-high-variance at 2026-03-26T16:12:43Z — severity: P2 — linked: https://incident.redwood/INC-20260326-42
Chris: taking primary. Thanks @Maya — any ongoing mitigations you want me to keep watching?
Maya: Yes — status: mitigations in place
Maya: 1) Autoscaler: pinned replicas to +20% for embeddings pool (manual override) — should smooth scaling. Watch metric: embeddings_scaler.scale_variance
Maya: 2) Routing: temporarily disabled eu-west spillover to us-west for embed-heavy routes — monitor egress packets. Metric: region_e2e_errors
Maya: 3) KV: rolled back kvstore v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 on 16:45 UTC for a subset of nodes. Followup: run eviction scan, see runbook.
Maya: Runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction
Alex: I'm on secondary — I'll pick up any pager noise if scaling re-triggers. Checking dashboards now.
Linh: quick note: we added a temporary alert mute for noisy autoscaler flapping so paging doesn't spam — only P0s will break through. Documented in the incident thread.
Sam: Customer comms: flagged a handful of impacted customers (internal tickets opened) — no external status page update needed yet. I'll escalate if delays exceed 30m for any customer job.
Chris: got it. Watching the autoscaler feed and region_e2e_errors. If we see scale variance > 0.7 for 3 consecutive windows, I'll trigger scale-policy rollback. 
Chris: Reassigning a tiny follow-up: @Alex please run the `kv:eviction-scan` on nodes euw-3 and euw-4 once load stabilizes.
Alex: on it — ETA 12m. I'll post results in this thread.
ops-bot: [deploy] rollback initiated: kvstore 2.3.1 -> 2.3.0 by Maya at 2026-03-26T16:45:12Z
Maya: Note: when you run the eviction scan use this snippet:
Maya: ```
./tools/kv-scan --nodes euw-3,euw-4 --threshold 0.75 --output /tmp/kv-evict-scan.json
```
Alex: eviction scan complete on euw-3,euw-4 — low tail evictions, found 3 hosts with >80% ephemeral pressure. Results: /tmp/kv-evict-scan.json. Pushing small config tweak to reduce TTL churn; will monitor.
Chris: thanks. Next steps for night:
Chris: - Keep replicas pinned until 02:00 UTC, then try gentle autoscale re-enable with 15% buffer
Chris: - Alex to confirm eviction scan cleared or escalate
Chris: - Linh to monitor paging noise and adjust thresholds if we get flapping
Chris: - Sam to update customer tickets if any job delay crosses 30m
Maya: FYI, I've logged a postmortem stub: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260326-42/pm -- fill in details tomorrow. Put any followups here. :memo:
Sam: will update tickets and reply to affected customers if needed. Current ETA to normal: 20-40m depending on TTL churn.
Alex: will keep monitoring — will shout if anything regresses.
Chris: thanks team. Taking primary — I'm reachable on pager and DM. Passing off at 17:02 UTC. Good handoff.
Maya: thanks, everyone. Standby until handoff complete. :raised_hands:
